required_gate: Actual per-case solve/flux/field and applicable radius-specific mesh/SUPG evidence
main_question: How do voltage and hole radius change the accepted current-work branch fields?

trend_figure.uncomputed_comparators: No LQ or old-heat curves will be invented or spliced into these nine NT cases.

cloud_figures.surface_checks: Review top/bottom carrier extrema before treating the midplane as representative.
cloud_figures.stress_definition: Total sigma=C:epsilon-e^T E-beta theta; a separate -beta theta panel, if used, is only the constitutive thermal-expansion term.
rows: enlarged scalar-height surfaces of the identical field
cloud_figures.style_policy: Reuse complete layout, fonts, view, palette and export settings. Replace old numerical limits with common actual-data limits across six endpoint/radius states for each quantity.
cloud_figures.mesh_evaluation: Element-local HEX20 evaluation; retain derivative jumps and the actual hole radius; no global smoothing or hole interpolation.

carrier_policy: Report n0 and p0, relative perturbations and absolute ranges; a large relative hole change does not imply large absolute hole density.
power_policy: Report all-physical-exterior and electrode-only power separately; never add SUPG work to physical heat or terminal power.
preserve: All old figures and data remain unchanged; new figures require a new output directory and provenance.
